text: The ninth day is over, you are coming nearer and nearer to the closing day of ten days Thammaseminar.
Having worked seriously for nine days on this technique, understand how you will make use of this technique in your day-to-day life.
If you don't do that, then the purpose of your joining a course like this is not served.
Then it will become like a rite, a ritual, a vipassana rite, a vipassana ritual.
It won't be helpful. Vipassana is not for that purpose.
Vipassana is an art of living.
